headline: US Retail Diesel Prices Fall Below $6 a Gallon to Two-Month Low
summary: U.S. average diesel prices fell below $6 per gallon, marking a two-month low. The price drop was driven by easing geopolitical tensions and weaker domestic fuel demand.
why: Diesel is the primary fuel for heavy logistics, freight transport, and industrial production, serving as a key benchmark for shipping costs.

impacts.name: Heating Oil / Diesel Futures
impacts.why: Slower demand and reduced geopolitical tension pull U.S. diesel prices below $6 a gallon.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
